panel1.title: About SAMI Summer Course
panel1.text1: SAMI Summer Course is an international academic program held since 2017 by the Department of Management, IPB University. Its goals? To enhance institutional competitiveness, expand global networks, and provide cross-cultural learning experiences through inter-country collaboration.
panel1.text2: The 9th edition this year runs hybrid from 27 July – 15 August 2026, with the main location at IPB Dramaga Campus, Bogor. There are 14 courses on sustainable agrifood management — 12 online courses (2 credits) plus an additional offline track with 2 hybrid courses and field visits (4 credits). There's also an essay contest to sharpen participants' analytical skills.
panel1.theme: Theme: "Building Climate Resilience and Sustainable Agrifood Management through ESG"

panel2.title: Program Objectives
items: Enhance participants' knowledge and skills in specific fields of study
Interactive learning with collaborative approaches
Expand international networks between participants and host institutions
Introduce local culture to international participants and strengthen cultural diplomacy

gettingReady.title: Getting Ready for SAMI 2026
gettingReady.subtitle: Prepare for online sessions and the in-person experience in Bogor & Garut.

panel1.title: Before Online Sessions
items: Test Zoom first to avoid technical issues
Mute microphone when not speaking, use full name for easy identification
Slides shared via WhatsApp group one day prior, or via portal samiipb.site
Use Q&A box or prefix chat with "[ASK]" to ask speakers
Turn on camera and use official virtual background (ipb.link/vbg-sami-2026)

panel2.title: Essential Items for Site Visit
items: Passport & travel documents (keep copies on phone, wallet, bag, and suitcase)
Universal power adapter — Indonesia uses type C/F, 220V, 50Hz
Personal medication (organizers only provide basic medicine)
Cash (Rupiah) plus local SIM card or travel WiFi
Light comfortable clothing, hat, rain jacket/umbrella, comfortable walking shoes

panel3.title: Things to Know Before Coming to Indonesia
items: Currency: Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). Digital wallets (GoPay, OVO) widely used in cities
Local SIM cards available at airport...
Timezone: WIB (UTC+7)...
Weather in July-August: dry season, 24-32°C...

items.a: SAMI (Sustainable Agrifood Management in Indonesia) is an annual international summer course from Department of Management, IPB University, running since 2017. The 9th edition (2026) is held hybrid 27 July – 15 August, with 14 courses on sustainable agrifood management, essay contest, and field visits in Bogor & Garut.
Two options: Online Course Track (12 live online sessions, 2 credits) and Online + Site Visit Track (12 online sessions + 2 hybrid courses on campus + field visits, 4 credits).

Registration opens 28 April – 17 July 2026, announcement 17 July, and payment deadline 20 July 2026. For fee details, check the program book at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1D1NC92bcacJQB1MCXLwprNpfzdUK8Fk0/view.
Submit application via ipb.link/submission-sami-2026. Read the full program book at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1D1NC92bcacJQB1MCXLwprNpfzdUK8Fk0/view.
12 online sessions run 27–31 July 2026 via Zoom. Slides shared via WhatsApp group one day prior, and also on learning portal samiipb.site.

items.q: What happens during the onsite portion?
items.a: Offline participants arrive in Bogor 9 August, attend 2 hybrid courses (10 & 14 August), and 9 field visits in Bogor & Garut from 10–15 August — including IPB Dramaga Campus, Eptilu agrotourism, Mandalagiri coffee cooperative, Margawati sheep/goat center, Bestory dodol production, Sukaregang leather market, Cangkuang Temple, IPB Science Technopark, and Bogor Botanical Garden.

Yes. Participants who complete the program receive Certificate of Completion, Certificate of Participation for Essay Contest, and credit transcripts (4 credits for full program, 2 credits for online only) issued by Department of Management IPB University.

The essay contest is part of the project assignment. Groups submit essays (max. 3,000 words) plus presentation, with final presentation 14 August at Start Up Science Technopark, Bogor. Top 3 essays get certificates & cash prizes (1st: IDR 3,000,000, 2nd: IDR 2,000,000, 3rd: IDR 1,000,000), and all accepted essays published in SAMI Proceeding with ISBN.

items.q: What is the language of instruction?
items.a: All sessions and essays use English.
